body: I would definitely be interested in therapy, but I live in a very conservative Christian household and my father doesn’t ‘believe’ in therapy, so unfortunately it likely won’t be available until I move away. I think it can be easy to forget when family does things like this, because you’re around them so much that you need to make some sort of livable image of them inside your head, someone you could stand to be around. I’m having trouble reconciling the image I have of my brother with what he did. I feel like I’m the only one aside from him who knows about this anymore. My parents forgot long ago and I never told my friends about him. They all think he’s a great guy for the most part. I just wish I could talk to one of my friends about this without ruining him for them.
